sents.zh: 清朝有一个很有名的皇帝，叫康熙。
sents.en: The Qing dynasty had a famous emperor called Kangxi.

sents.zh: 他八岁的时候就做了皇帝。
sents.en: He became emperor at the age of eight.

sents.zh: 因为他还很小，所以一开始有别人帮他。
sents.en: Because he was so young, others helped him at first.

sents.zh: 他十几岁的时候，才开始自己做事。
sents.en: Only in his teens did he begin to rule himself.

sents.zh: 他一共做了六十一年皇帝。
sents.en: He was emperor for sixty-one years in all.

sents.zh: 他每天很早就起来做事。
sents.en: He rose very early every day to work.

sents.zh: 他也非常喜欢学新的东西。
他学过数学，也学过西边来的学问。
sents.en: He studied mathematics, and learning that came from the west.

sents.zh: 西边来的人给他讲天上的事情。
sents.en: People from the west told him about the heavens.

sents.zh: 他还让人给他做了很多书。
sents.en: He also had many books made for him.

sents.zh: 他让人走过全国，画了一张很大的地图。
sents.en: He sent men across the whole country to make a great map.

sents.zh: 那时候，中国比以前大了很多。
sents.en: At that time China was far larger than before.

sents.zh: 他也关心种田的人，问过很多地方的事。
sents.en: He cared about the farmers, and asked about many places.

sents.zh: 虽然做皇帝很累，但是他一直没有停。
sents.en: Although being emperor was exhausting, he never stopped.

sents.zh: 所以很多人说，他是中国最好的皇帝之一。
sents.en: So many say he was one of China’s finest emperors.
